tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gtsang stod 'dar gyi chos grwa'i bskor bsrungs rnam gnyis mchod pa'i cho ga/ oṃ swasti/ dam can skyes bu chen po dang / bdud mo mched bzhi mchod par 'dod pas/ so so'i gtor ma lag len ltar bshams/ nang mchod chu chang gis bran nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po/ rnam pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus pa'i phung po stong gsum dang mnyam par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas 'dzam gling nub phyogs/ pha wang long bu'i mkhar nang nas dam can skyes bu chen po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / bod yul gyi rang rang bzhugs pa'i gnas rnams nas rab 'jigs bdud mo mched bzhi/ khyad par lung gnyan gyi re ma ti lcam dral bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye satwaṃ/ sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra sa dhu sa mā ya/ sa ma traṃ traṃ/ shi ni tra ma ni/ sa ma ya sa dhu tri dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ i dāṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum dang / trag rak+sha snying kha rag ma bh+yo/ sa pā ri wā ra i dāṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ gsum/ ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi/ ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ kyai/ sngon tshe rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / /pad+ma'i rgyal po thod phreng gis/ /bka' yi bsrung mar gnyer gtad pa'i/ /dam can mgar ba nag po che/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mun pa'i mdog /phyag g.yas khro chu'i tho chen 'phyar/ /g.yon pas sbud pa nag po 'bud/ /zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan dmar bsgrad/ /dbu la 'bas zhu nag po gsol/ /sku la 'jol ber nag po gyon/ /rgyob gsod nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /zhal nas dug gi rlangs pa 'tshub/ /chibs su ra rgod kham nag chibs/ /stong gsum skad cig gcig la nyul/ /sprul pa bye ba sa ya 'gyed/ /dpa' bo ging chen sde bzhi dang / /mched zla sum brgya drug cu dang /

/dges sde bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs/ /dregs byed rgya mtsho'i 'khor bcas rnams/ /'dir byon sha khrag gtor ma bzhes/ /sman raka bdud rtsi'i gser skyems bzhes/ /mthun pa'i dam rdzas mchod pa bzhes/ /spyan gzigs dam tshig rten la dgongs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam ma 'da'/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' ma bcag /bdag gi dgon gnas longs spyod dang / /'khor 'bangs slob ma dkor rdzas rnams/ /khyod la bcol zhing gnyer du gtad/ /nyin gsum bya ra ma g.yel cig /mtshan gsum mel tshe ma g.yel cig /'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen bsgrubs/ /dar zhing rgyas la bstan pa dang / /thams cad chos bzhin spyod pa dang / /byang chub bsgrub pa mthar phyin mdzod/ /bcol bzhin gtad pa'i dngos rnams la/ /rku 'phrog 'joms shing 'tshe ba dang / /brnyas shing smod pa'i dgra bgegs la/ /ma thogs myur ba de nyid du/ /khyod kyi mthu stobs drag po yis/ /ltas dang cho 'phrul mi bzad pa/ /bzod par dka' ba mngon sum phob/ /las nyon bskyed pa'i sha khrag rus/ /dum bur btub la hab kyis zo/ /ma g.yel ma g.yel bcol ba'i las/ /grub par mdzod cig sa ma ya/ /zhes pas dam can dang / bh+yo/ bod khams yul skyong bstan ma yongs kyi gtso/ /rab 'jigs dam can bdud mo mched bzhi ni/ /sngon tshe 'og min bde chen pho brang du/ /dbang chen rngam pas bka' dang dam la btags/ /slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /shar phyogs rgya yi bkra shis khri sgo nas/ /spyan drangs bod yul bsam yas gtsug lag tu/ /dam la btags shing bstan pa'i srung mar bskos/ /de nas mnga' ris khyung lung dngul mkhar du/ /drag sngags slob dpon shan+tiṃ gar+bha yis/ /bka' yi gnyer gtad dkor bsrung mchog tu grags/ /'jig rten dbang phyug tsan+d+ra dh+wa dza yis/ /rjes su 'brangs nas rmu rdzing gtsug lag sogs/ /yongs su skyong ba'i dam can ma mo bzhi/ /khyad par tha chung bdud mo re ma ti/

/srin mo dmar nag khrag gi ral pa can/ /me 'od 'bar ba'i rak+ta mig gcig ma/ /phyag g.yas mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i g.yab mo gdeb/ /g.yon pa dgra snying gzir ba'i lcags phur dang / /dam nyams rtsis la 'debs pa'i mgo 'phreng 'dzin/ /khrag rgyun thig pa'i g.yag lpags rlon pa gyon/ /rlung gi shugs can 'bri rgod dmar nag chibs/ /bam ro rlon pa lnga brgya khal du bkal/ /dug sbrul nag po stong gi thag pas bsdams/ /g.yas kyi ru 'dren btsan rgod rta zhon 'bum/ /g.yon gyi ru 'dren nag mo g.yag zhon 'bum/ /rgyab kyi rjes 'breng byang 'brog 'jigs pa brgyad/ /mdun gyi sna 'dren bdud g.yag rog po brgya/ /lcags mo hor pa brgya ni klad nas lding / /khyi mo nag mo stong ngu rol du khrid/ /sprul pa'i bud med nag mos stong khams khyab/ /mched lcam bdud btsan rgyal po phyi bzhin 'brengs/ /me rlung bu yug 'tshub mas phyogs mtha' dor/ /sde brgyad dregs pa kun gyi sna 'dren la/ /bskul lo bos so dam can bdud po'i tshogs/ /'dir byon rnal 'byor bdag gi bsgrub khang nang / /ma gcig 'bod cing rten pa'i dam rdzas ni/ /snyug rgod mda' dang dar nag 'phan rings dang / /gsang ba'i bla rdo srog 'khor snying sna'i tshogs/ /sha chen zan bcas sman phud rak+ta'i mchod/ /rus klad don snying nang khrol ban+dha bcas/ /gsur chen spos dud rnga chen gdung dbyangs kyis/ /bskang ngo mchod do dam can bdud mo'i tshogs/ /'bod do bskul lo rdo rje khyung lung ma/ /gsang mtshan drag mo e ka mi zan ma/ /khyod la phrin las gnyer du gtad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi dgon gnas longs spyod dang / /dad pa'i sbyin bdag gus pa'i rtsar slob dang / /mi nor phyugs gsum bstan pa ltos bcas rnams/ /bcol lo gtad do bsrung skyob sba bar mdzod/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod/ /'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus bsgrubs/

/gal te zhi bas 'dul bar mi mtshams pa'i/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mi dang mi ma yin/ /brnyas shing smod pa'i bstan pa bshig byed na/ /de tshe bdud mo dam bcas dran bgyis la/ /khro zhing 'khrug pas lcags spyang mjug ring dang / /ltas ngan sprul pas dgra yul ma lus kheng / /kha rlangs nad kyi bu yug sprin ltar stibs/ /dpa' bo btsan gyi rta dmag de la rgyug /gson sha bdud po nag po'i khram la thob/ /srog bdag gying gi cho 'phrul dgra la phob/ /ma bdud 'bum sde'i sle nag g.yab mo thob/ /bdud g.yag rog po'i tshogs kyis rwa brdar gyis/ /khyi mo nag mo'i tshogs kyis bla tshe khug /lcags khra nag pos don snying spar gyis thob/ /rlung nag bu yug 'tshub mas phyogs bcur thor/ /mdor na khyod kyi mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /zhag dang za ma skad cig de nyid la/ /dgra bgegs log par lta ba'i tshogs rnams kun/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ces brjod cing rol sgra drag po dang bcas pas gtor ma khang steng sogs sa gtsang sar btang ngo / /gtsang stod 'dar gyi chos grwa'i bskor bsrungs rnam gnyis mchod pa'i cho ga 'di ni slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas dang / shan+tiṃ gar+bha'i gzhung bzhin rgyud zab ma chad pa'i man ngag la brten nas rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gsal gyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ gtsang stod 'dar gyi chos grwa'i bskor bsrungs rnam gnyis mchod pa'i cho ga PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
